name: Amazon Security Lake (OCSF) sources
description: Six AWS log sources normalized to OCSF by Amazon Security Lake and indexed verbatim: CloudTrail and EKS audit API activity, Route 53 Resolver DNS queries, VPC Flow Logs connections, AWS WAF HTTP inspections and Security Hub findings (detection, compliance and vulnerability).
source: OCSF 1.1.0 schema (schema.ocsf.io); AWS Security Lake's own OCSF source-identification table; Splunk_TA_aws props.conf for the six [ocsf:aws:*] stanzas

feed.label: Amazon Security Lake (OCSF) sources
feed.description: AWS log sources as Amazon Security Lake converts them to OCSF and Splunk_TA_aws indexes them verbatim: CloudTrail and EKS audit API calls, Route 53 Resolver DNS queries, VPC Flow Logs connections, AWS WAF HTTP inspections and Security Hub findings.

ocsf_class.label: OCSF class
ocsf_class.description: Which OCSF event class the record belongs to; decides which other attributes are present. The discriminator for this family.

ocsf_category.label: OCSF category
ocsf_category.description: The broader grouping a class belongs to (category_uid, category_name): Findings, Network Activity or Application Activity.

ocsf_type_tag.label: OCSF type tag
ocsf_type_tag.description: type_uid and type_name: a calculated fully-qualified name for the record (class_uid times 100, plus activity_id), for example 'Network Activity: Refuse'.

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: How severe OCSF normalizes this record's severity (severity_id, severity); shared across every class in this family.

event_status.label: Event status
event_status.description: Whether the call this record describes succeeded (status_id, status); seen on the API Activity records.

action.label: Action
action.description: The policy decision a network control made on this connection or query (action_id, action).

disposition.label: Disposition
disposition.description: The finer-grained outcome a security control reached (disposition_id, disposition): what actually happened to the request or connection, beyond plain allow/deny.

observable_name.label: Observable pointer
observable_name.description: Which attribute of this same record the observable entry is pivoting on, given as a dotted path, e.g. actor.user.name.

observable_type.label: Observable type
observable_type.description: What kind of thing the observable's value is (type_id, type): a hostname, IP address, hash, resource id or one of 23 fixed OCSF kinds.

observable_value.label: Observable value
observable_value.description: The pivotable value itself, copied from the attribute observable_name points at.

cloud_provider.label: Cloud provider
cloud_provider.description: The cloud vendor the record's resources live in; AWS on every record in this family.

cloud_region.label: Cloud region
cloud_region.description: The AWS Region the event or resource belongs to.

cloud_account_id.label: Cloud account id
cloud_account_id.description: The AWS account id the record's resources belong to.

cloud_zone.label: Availability zone
cloud_zone.description: The AWS Availability Zone the record's resource runs in.

metadata_product_name.label: Product name
metadata_product_name.description: Which AWS service produced the underlying log, per AWS Security Lake's own source-identification table.

metadata_product_vendor.label: Product vendor
metadata_product_vendor.description: The vendor of the product that generated the record; AWS throughout this family.

metadata_product_feature.label: Product feature
metadata_product_feature.description: Which feature of the product produced the record, per AWS Security Lake's source table.

metadata_profiles.label: OCSF profiles
metadata_profiles.description: Which optional OCSF profiles (attribute bundles) this record was built with, e.g. cloud, security_control, datetime.

metadata_version.label: OCSF schema version
metadata_version.description: The OCSF schema version this record was produced against, SemVer.

metadata_product_version.label: Product version
metadata_product_version.description: The version of the AWS service/product that produced the record.

metadata_uid.label: Metadata event id
metadata_uid.description: A unique id the logging system assigned to this event instance.

metadata_log_version.label: Source log schema version
metadata_log_version.description: The version of the original (pre-OCSF) log format this record was mapped from, e.g. the Kubernetes audit.k8s.io API version.

metadata_log_level.label: Audit level
metadata_log_level.description: The audit level the original log was generated at.

metadata_processed_time.label: Processed time
metadata_processed_time.description: When Security Lake's own pipeline processed this record, distinct from when the underlying event happened.

metadata_extensions.label: Schema extensions
metadata_extensions.description: Which OCSF schema extensions were used to build this record.

src_ip.label: Source address
src_ip.description: The network address the connection, query or request came from.

src_port.label: Source port
src_port.description: The TCP or UDP port the connection came from.

dst_ip.label: Destination address
dst_ip.description: The network address the connection was made to.

dst_port.label: Destination port
dst_port.description: The TCP or UDP port the connection was made to.

endpoint_instance_uid.label: Instance id
endpoint_instance_uid.description: The EC2 instance (or resolver endpoint) id behind this network endpoint.

endpoint_interface_uid.label: Network interface id
endpoint_interface_uid.description: The elastic network interface id the traffic crossed.

endpoint_subnet_uid.label: Subnet id
endpoint_subnet_uid.description: The VPC subnet id the network interface sits in.

endpoint_vpc_uid.label: VPC id
endpoint_vpc_uid.description: The VPC id the endpoint belongs to.

endpoint_svc_name.label: Endpoint service name
endpoint_svc_name.description: The name of the AWS-managed service behind this endpoint, when there is one, else a placeholder.

endpoint_uid.label: Endpoint resource id
endpoint_uid.description: The id of the AWS resource (load balancer, API Gateway stage, CloudFront distribution) that terminated this HTTP request.

endpoint_country.label: Endpoint country
endpoint_country.description: The country GeoIP maps this endpoint's address to.

connection_direction.label: Connection direction
connection_direction.description: Which way the connection or query is travelling relative to the VPC boundary (direction_id, direction).

connection_protocol_name.label: Protocol name
connection_protocol_name.description: The IANA transport protocol name in lowercase.

connection_protocol_ver.label: IP version
connection_protocol_ver.description: Which IP version this connection used.

connection_boundary.label: Connection boundary
connection_boundary.description: Where this connection crosses relative to the VPC: same VPC, an internet or virtual private gateway, VPC peering, or one of 13 fixed OCSF boundaries.

connection_tcp_flags.label: TCP flags
connection_tcp_flags.description: The bitwise-OR of TCP control flags seen across the flow's aggregation window.

traffic_bytes.label: Bytes transferred
traffic_bytes.description: The number of bytes transferred during the flow's aggregation window.

traffic_packets.label: Packets transferred
traffic_packets.description: The number of packets transferred during the flow's aggregation window.

start_time.label: Start time
start_time.description: When this flow or operation began.

flow_status_code.label: Flow log status
flow_status_code.description: Whether VPC Flow Logs captured this aggregation window normally.

firewall_rule_uid.label: Firewall rule id
firewall_rule_uid.description: The id of the rule that decided this record's disposition.

activity_api.label: API activity
activity_api.description: Which CRUD-style bucket this API call falls into (activity_id, activity_name); shared by CloudTrail and EKS audit, both API Activity class.

activity_network.label: Network activity
activity_network.description: The connection lifecycle stage this record reports (activity_id, activity_name); Network Activity class, VPC Flow Logs.

activity_http.label: HTTP activity
activity_http.description: The HTTP method this request used, normalized (activity_id, activity_name); HTTP Activity class, AWS WAF.

activity_dns.label: DNS activity
activity_dns.description: Whether this record reports a query or a traffic summary (activity_id, activity_name); DNS Activity class, Route 53 Resolver.

activity_finding.label: Finding activity
activity_finding.description: Whether this finding record is a create, update or close (activity_id, activity_name); shared by all three Security Hub finding classes.

api_operation.label: API operation
api_operation.description: The API verb/operation this call invoked, e.g. DescribeDirectConnectGateways.

api_service_name.label: API service name
api_service_name.description: Which AWS service endpoint received the call.

api_request_uid.label: API request id
api_request_uid.description: The unique id AWS assigned to this API request; ties CloudTrail records to the AWS-side request log.

api_response_data.label: API response body
api_response_data.description: The API call's response payload, as the service returned it.

api_response_code.label: API response code
api_response_code.description: The status code the Kubernetes API server returned for this request.

api_version.label: API group version
api_version.description: The Kubernetes API group/version this call targeted, e.g. v1.

actor_user_name.label: Actor user name
actor_user_name.description: The human-readable IAM user name that made the call.

actor_user_uid.label: Actor principal
actor_user_uid.description: The actor's own identifier: an IAM principal ARN for CloudTrail, absent for the EKS worker-node identity in this sample.

actor_user_uid_alt.label: Actor unique id
actor_user_uid_alt.description: A second, stable IAM identifier for the actor that survives a user rename, distinct from the ARN.

actor_credential_uid.label: Credential id
actor_credential_uid.description: The id of the credential (access key or session token) that authenticated this call.

actor_user_type.label: Actor identity type
actor_user_type.description: What kind of AWS or Kubernetes identity the actor is.

actor_account_uid.label: Actor account id
actor_account_uid.description: The AWS account id the actor's identity belongs to.

actor_session_uid.label: Session id
actor_session_uid.description: The Kubernetes API server's session identifier for this authenticated connection.

actor_session_issuer.label: Session issuer
actor_session_issuer.description: The IAM principal (ARN) that issued the credentials behind this session, e.g. the assumed role.

actor_user_groups.label: Actor groups
actor_user_groups.description: The Kubernetes RBAC groups the actor's identity belongs to, e.g. system:masters, system:authenticated.

resources_name.label: Kubernetes object name
resources_name.description: The name of the Kubernetes object this audit event's request or response body describes.

resources_namespace.label: Kubernetes namespace
resources_namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace the object lives in; empty for cluster-scoped objects such as Node.

resources_type.label: Kubernetes object kind
resources_type.description: The Kubernetes Kind of the affected object, e.g. Node, Pod, ConfigMap.

resources_uid.label: Kubernetes object uid
resources_uid.description: The Kubernetes-assigned unique id of the object.

resources_version.label: Kubernetes apiVersion
resources_version.description: The Kubernetes apiVersion the affected object was read or written under.

eks_message.label: Audit message
eks_message.description: A short, source-specific summary line for the audit event.

query_hostname.label: Query hostname
query_hostname.description: The domain name the client queried.

query_type.label: DNS record type
query_type.description: The DNS resource record type of the query or answer, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME.

query_class.label: DNS record class
query_class.description: The DNS class of the query or answer; almost always IN (internet).

dns_answer_rdata.label: Answer data
dns_answer_rdata.description: The resource data the DNS answer carried, e.g. the resolved IP address.

rcode.label: Response code
rcode.description: The DNS server's response code for the query, per RFC 6895 (rcode_id, rcode).

dns_firewall_domain_list_id.label: DNS Firewall domain list id
dns_firewall_domain_list_id.description: The id of the Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall domain list that matched this query, when one did.

vpcflow_sublocation_type.label: Sublocation type
vpcflow_sublocation_type.description: Whether this flow's network interface sits in a Wavelength zone, an Outpost or a Local Zone.

vpcflow_sublocation_id.label: Sublocation id
vpcflow_sublocation_id.description: The id of the sublocation named by sublocation_type.

http_url_hostname.label: Request hostname
http_url_hostname.description: The Host header (or CloudFront/ALB-resolved host) the request targeted.

http_url_path.label: Request path
http_url_path.description: The URL path component of the request.

http_request_uid.label: HTTP request id
http_request_uid.description: The id the front-end AWS service (ALB, CloudFront, API Gateway) assigned this request; the ALB trace id for Application Load Balancer.

http_request_version.label: HTTP version
http_request_version.description: The HTTP protocol version of the request.

http_request_args.label: Query string
http_request_args.description: The request's query string arguments, as AWS WAF captured them.

http_x_forwarded_for.label: X-Forwarded-For
http_x_forwarded_for.description: The client address chain a proxy or load balancer recorded ahead of this request.

http_status.label: HTTP status code
http_status.description: The numeric HTTP response status code, when AWS WAF's log captured one for this request.

tls_ja3_hash.label: JA3 hash
tls_ja3_hash.description: The MD5 hash of the client's TLS ClientHello fingerprint (JA3).

ja4_fingerprint.label: JA4 fingerprint
ja4_fingerprint.description: A 36-character hash of the client's TLS ClientHello, a newer alternative to JA3.

firewall_rule_name.label: Firewall rule name
firewall_rule_name.description: The human-assigned name of the rule.

firewall_rule_type.label: Firewall rule type
firewall_rule_type.description: What kind of rule matched: an ordinary rule, a rate-based rule, or a rule group.

firewall_rule_condition.label: Match condition
firewall_rule_condition.description: The category of threat or condition the rule tested for, e.g. SQL_INJECTION.

firewall_rule_match_location.label: Match location
firewall_rule_match_location.description: Which part of the request the matched data was found in.

firewall_rule_match_details.label: Match details
firewall_rule_match_details.description: The literal data in the request that triggered the rule.

firewall_rule_rate_limit.label: Rate limit
firewall_rule_rate_limit.description: The configured request-rate ceiling for a rate-based rule.

firewall_rule_sensitivity.label: Rule sensitivity
firewall_rule_sensitivity.description: The configured sensitivity level of the matched inspection rule (e.g. a SQLi/XSS body-inspection rule).

waf_rule_group_id.label: Rule group id
waf_rule_group_id.description: The id of the rule group that acted on this request.

waf_http_fragment.label: URL fragment
waf_http_fragment.description: The part of the request URL after the # symbol.

waf_http_host.label: Raw Host header
waf_http_host.description: The Host header value AWS WAF's httpRequest object captured, before any front-end normalization.

waf_http_scheme.label: Request scheme
waf_http_scheme.description: The URL scheme (http/https) AWS WAF's httpRequest object captured.

compliance_control.label: Compliance control
compliance_control.description: The specific control (e.g. a Security Hub control or CIS benchmark item) this finding checks.

compliance_requirements.label: Compliance requirements
compliance_requirements.description: Which specific requirements of a standard (e.g. a NIST 800-53 control) this finding is checked against.

compliance_standards.label: Compliance standards
compliance_standards.description: Which named standards or benchmarks this finding is evaluated against.

finding_status.label: Finding status
finding_status.description: Where this finding stands in its lifecycle; the same normalized status backs both the finding's top-level status and its nested compliance.status.

evidence_data.label: Evidence data
evidence_data.description: The raw artifact data backing one piece of supporting evidence for a Detection Finding.

evidence_city.label: Evidence source city
evidence_city.description: The city GeoIP maps the evidence's source address to.

evidence_coordinates.label: Evidence source coordinates
evidence_coordinates.description: The latitude/longitude GeoIP maps the evidence's source address to.

finding_uid.label: Finding id
finding_uid.description: The unique id of this finding, stable across its create/update/close lifecycle.

finding_title.label: Finding title
finding_title.description: A short phrase summarizing the finding.

finding_desc.label: Finding description
finding_desc.description: The full description of the finding.

finding_types.label: Finding types
finding_types.description: The taxonomy path(s) the finding provider classified this finding under.

finding_src_url.label: Finding source URL
finding_src_url.description: A link to this finding in the originating product's own console.

finding_first_seen_time.label: Finding first seen
finding_first_seen_time.description: When the underlying issue was first observed; can predate created_time.

finding_last_seen_time.label: Finding last seen
finding_last_seen_time.description: When the underlying issue was most recently observed.

finding_modified_time.label: Finding modified time
finding_modified_time.description: When the finding record was last modified.

remediation_desc.label: Remediation guidance
remediation_desc.description: The recommended fix, for the finding as a whole or for one affected package.

remediation_references.label: Remediation references
remediation_references.description: Supporting URLs for the remediation guidance.

finding_resource_uid.label: Affected resource id
finding_resource_uid.description: The id of the AWS resource this finding is about.

finding_resource_type.label: Affected resource type
finding_resource_type.description: The AWS resource type this finding is about, e.g. AwsEc2Instance.

finding_resource_region.label: Affected resource region
finding_resource_region.description: The AWS Region the affected resource lives in.

finding_resource_partition.label: Affected resource partition
finding_resource_partition.description: The AWS partition the affected resource lives in: standard, China or GovCloud.

finding_resource_data.label: Affected resource data
finding_resource_data.description: A snapshot of the affected resource's own attributes, shape depends on its resource type.

cve_uid.label: CVE id
cve_uid.description: The CVE identifier for the vulnerability.

cve_cvss_base_score.label: CVSS base score
cve_cvss_base_score.description: The CVSS numeric severity score for the CVE.

cve_cvss_vector.label: CVSS vector
cve_cvss_vector.description: The CVSS vector string the base score was computed from.

cve_cvss_version.label: CVSS version
cve_cvss_version.description: Which CVSS scoring standard version this score uses.

cve_created_time.label: CVE created time
cve_created_time.description: When this CVE record was published.

cve_modified_time.label: CVE modified time
cve_modified_time.description: When this CVE record was last updated upstream.

cve_epss_score.label: EPSS score
cve_epss_score.description: The Exploit Prediction Scoring System probability that this CVE is exploited in the next 30 days.

vuln_is_exploit_available.label: Exploit available
vuln_is_exploit_available.description: Whether a public exploit or proof-of-concept exists for this vulnerability.

vuln_is_fix_available.label: Fix available
vuln_is_fix_available.description: Whether a vendor fix exists for this vulnerability.

vuln_vendor_name.label: Vulnerability vendor
vuln_vendor_name.description: The vendor or scanner that identified the vulnerability, e.g. Amazon Inspector.

vuln_references.label: Vulnerability references
vuln_references.description: Reference URLs for the vulnerability as a whole.

pkg_name.label: Package name
pkg_name.description: The name of an affected software package.

pkg_version.label: Package version
pkg_version.description: The installed version of the affected package.

pkg_fixed_in_version.label: Fixed-in version
pkg_fixed_in_version.description: The package version that resolves the vulnerability, when known.

pkg_architecture.label: Package architecture
pkg_architecture.description: The CPU architecture the affected package was built for.

pkg_epoch.label: Package epoch
pkg_epoch.description: The package manager's epoch field, used to order versions when the version string alone cannot.

pkg_package_manager.label: Package manager
pkg_package_manager.description: Which package manager or ecosystem the affected package belongs to.

pkg_release.label: Package release
pkg_release.description: The distribution-specific release field of the affected package's version.

unmapped_recipient_account.label: Recipient account id
unmapped_recipient_account.description: CloudTrail's own recipientAccountId field, preserved verbatim in unmapped because OCSF's mapping did not carry it into cloud.account.uid on every record shape.

securityhub_record_state.label: Record state
securityhub_record_state.description: Whether Security Hub still shows this finding as active.

securityhub_workflow_state.label: Workflow state
securityhub_workflow_state.description: The retired single-value predecessor of ASFF's Workflow.Status investigation-tracking field.

securityhub_sample.label: Sample finding flag
securityhub_sample.description: Whether this finding is one of Security Hub's own fictitious sample findings, not a real detection.

k8s_event_kind.label: Audit event kind
k8s_event_kind.description: The Kubernetes API object kind of the audit log entry itself; Event on every record.

k8s_object_kind.label: Kubernetes object kind (raw)
k8s_object_kind.description: The Kind of the object in the request or response body, from the original Kubernetes audit record.

k8s_object_name.label: Kubernetes object name (raw)
k8s_object_name.description: The name of the object in the request or response body, from the original Kubernetes audit record.

k8s_source_ips.label: Kubernetes audit source IPs
k8s_source_ips.description: The client address chain the Kubernetes API server itself recorded, from the original audit record's sourceIPs list.

k8s_provider_id.label: Node provider id
k8s_provider_id.description: The cloud-provider identity string Kubernetes stores for this Node, linking it back to the EC2 instance.

record_time.label: Event time
record_time.description: The record's own primary timestamp: when the underlying activity happened, per OCSF's normalization.

metadata_event_code.label: Source event code
metadata_event_code.description: CloudTrail's own eventType value (e.g. AwsApiCall), carried through into OCSF's metadata.event_code.

http_header.label: HTTP header
http_header.description: One captured request header's name or value.

http_referrer.label: HTTP referrer
http_referrer.description: The Referer header of the request, when present.

ocsf:aws:cloudtrail.description: CloudTrail management, data and network activity events, delivered to Splunk_TA_aws as Amazon Security Lake's own OCSF API Activity mapping (class_uid 6003), one JSON object per event.
ocsf:aws:cloudtrail.note: KV_MODE=json only; no REPORT/FIELDALIAS/modinput touches this stanza (same shape as aws:asl). index_time_ok is false.

ocsf:aws:eks:audit.description: Amazon EKS control-plane (Kubernetes) audit log events, mapped by Security Lake to OCSF API Activity (class_uid 6003); the request/response Kubernetes object bodies survive in unmapped.*.
ocsf:aws:eks:audit.note: KV_MODE=json only, no modinput. The unmapped.* Node status/capacity/labels/conditions dump is large and mostly left out of this pack; see the report for what.

ocsf:aws:route53resolver.description: Route 53 Resolver query log entries, mapped by Security Lake to OCSF DNS Activity (class_uid 4003), one query-log record per event.
ocsf:aws:route53resolver.note: KV_MODE=json only, no modinput. index_time_ok is false.

ocsf:aws:vpcflow.description: VPC Flow Logs connection records, mapped by Security Lake to OCSF Network Activity (class_uid 4001), one flow-log aggregation-window record per event.

ocsf:aws:waf.description: AWS WAF web ACL traffic logs, mapped by Security Lake to OCSF HTTP Activity (class_uid 4002), one inspected request per event.
ocsf:aws:waf.note: KV_MODE=json, TIME_PREFIX targets the top-level time key specifically (time_dt is a second, nested timestamp string). index_time_ok is false.

ocsf:aws:securityhub:finding.description: AWS Security Hub findings (from GuardDuty, Inspector, compliance standard checks and Security Hub's own controls), mapped by Security Lake to one of three OCSF finding classes depending on the finding's own kind.
ocsf:aws:securityhub:finding.note: KV_MODE=json, no modinput. Carries three OCSF classes on one sourcetype: Detection Finding (GuardDuty-style), Compliance Finding (standard checks) and Vulnerability Finding (Inspector).
